shot_query.description: Original plain-language shot description requested by the editor.

decomposed_queries.description: List of targeted sub-queries generated by the Gemini Enterprise agent.

execution_time_ms.description: Total agent orchestration and tool execution runtime in milliseconds.

id.description: Unique identifier for this shortlisted clip candidate.

title.description: Descriptive title or headline of the clip.

source_name.description: Archive or stock footage vendor name (e.g. Prelinger Archives / Internet Archive, Library of Congress, British Pathé, Pond5, Getty).

source_url.description: Direct canonical URL to the source page or listing.

thumbnail_url.description: URL to image thumbnail preview or frame poster.

preview_video_url.description: Direct link or embed URL to playable video preview.

price.description: Extracted price (e.g., '$0 (Free)', '$79.00', '$149/sec', 'Request Quote'). null or 'Unable to verify' if not disclosed on page.

license_scope.description: Extracted rights description (e.g., 'Public Domain (No copyright)', 'Royalty-Free Worldwide', 'Editorial Use Only', 'Rights-Managed Film/TV').

resolution.description: Video resolution, frame rate, or scan format (e.g., '1080p 24fps', '4K ProRes 422', '35mm Film Transfer', 'Standard Def NTSC').

pd_claim.description: verified = strictly validated against verified institutional repositories; unverified = third-party site claims PD without legal institutional provenance; not_claimed = commercial/licensed.

relevance_score.description: Agent-assessed visual and semantic relevance to the shot query (0.00 to 1.00).

notes.description: Agent analysis commentary detailing licensing cautions, visual cues, archival provenance, or rights clearance suggestions.

monitored.description: Whether this clip candidate is currently enrolled in the Parallel Monitor tracking pipeline.
